title: Aplenty
description: Route parts through conditional workflows and count accepted rating combinations.
writeup:
## Approach

Parse workflows as named lists of conditional rules, each sending a part to another workflow or to Accept/Reject.

## Part 1

For each part, follow the workflow chain: evaluate conditions against the part's x/m/a/s ratings until reaching `A` or `R`. Sum the total ratings of all accepted parts.

## Part 2

Instead of individual parts, track ranges of possible values for each rating (initially 1–4000). At each condition, split the range: the portion satisfying the condition follows one path, the remainder continues to the next rule. Recursively count how many combinations reach `A` by multiplying the range sizes.
